Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates thin, vertical linear lucencies outlining the mediastinal structures (particularly along the left heart border and paratracheal region), which is characteristic of pneumomediastinum. In the context of an alcoholic binge (suggesting vomiting/Valsalva) and neck swelling, this supports a diagnosis of spontaneous pneumomediastinum caused by alveolar rupture (Macklin effect).
